title: Understand Any Threat Report in Minutes: AI Summaries and Attack Flow in Prime Architect
content_md: Every SOC analyst knows the feeling. A new threat report lands in your queue, dozens of pages long, packed with techniques, tools, and timelines. Somewhere inside is the information your team needs to defend better, but finding it takes time you rarely have. Prime Architect removes that bottleneck. Prime Architect is SOC Prime’s AI-powered workspace for threat research and detection engineering. It helps security teams move from raw threat intelligence to actionable defense, using agentic AI tools that do the heavy lifting. Paste a threat report in Prime Architect and AI can turn it into a short summary, a full summary, or a visual Attack Flow, depending on what you need. If you want to see how far a single report can go, take a look at our earlier article on AI-powered Deep Threat Research . This article focuses on three ways to understand a report quickly: reading it in brief, reading it in depth, or seeing it as a diagram. Contact Sales Why It Matters Detection engineering is only as fast as your ability to understand the threat in front of you. With AI, one threat report gives you: Faster triage. Pull the key insights out of a long report before deciding what deserves attention, instead of reading it end to end. A shared picture of the attack. Plain-language summaries and visual diagrams give analysts, engineers, and managers the same understanding of what the adversary did. Better communication. A visual depiction of the attack helps engineers explain it to non-technical
